entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The metal plane created by Karn as Argentum, renamed Mirrodin by Memnarch, and conquered by Phyrexians who remade it with nine spheres under Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A formerly phased-out plane whose war hosts help defeat New Phyrexia and which switches places with it.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The original nine-sphered metal plane of Yawgmoth that New Phyrexia recreates.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane whose World Tree sap tyrite the Phyrexians seek.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane where Jin-Gitaxias experiments on kami and compleats Tamiyo.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: A plane where Urabrask seeks Halo.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Sheoldred sets up sleeper agents.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The planeswalking golem who created Argentum, was exposed to the glistening oil, and was healed by the Mirran Resistance.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A golem created from the Mirari who rules Argentum, renames it Mirrodin, becomes mad from Phyrexian oil, and is killed by Glissa.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The white praetor, Grand Cenobite and Mother of Machines, who rules New Phyrexia and launches the invasion.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: The blue praetor, Core Augur, who experiments on kami and compleats Tamiyo.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The black praetor, Whispering One, who leads the Steel Thanes and sets up sleeper agents on Dominaria.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: The red praetor who leads the Quiet Furnace, supports the Mirran Resistance, and seeks Halo.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: The green praetor, Voice of Hunger, who retrieves tyrite from Kaldheim.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker who most visibly leads the Mirran Resistance.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Mirran elf who kills Memnarch and retains the true power in the Vicious Swarm.

entities.name: Slobad
entities.description: A goblin who ascended with Glissa's spark and now runs the Salvage Complex.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Sylvok who appears key to the Resistance's goal of purifying the plane.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker whose sacrifice heals Karn.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who fuses with Realmbreaker and switches Zhalfir with New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who gathers with the praetors to crown Elesh Norn and rebuilds Jin-Gitaxias's body.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker whose capture and compleation accelerate Realmbreaker.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who cleaves Sheoldred's Coliseum from the Dross Pits.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A Phyrexian to whom Elesh Norn designates the unification of the plane.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A planeswalker who welcomes Wrenn to Zhalfir.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker compleated by Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A planeswalker infected with a seed by Vorinclex on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who contacts Urabrask.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A Kamigawa figure who cuts Jin-Gitaxias in two.

entities.name: Kemba
entities.description: A leonin leader of the Lowlight camp.

entities.name: Ria Ivor
entities.description: The Hero of Bladehold who leads the Accorders.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: The Thane of Contracts, later compleated into Vishgraz by Ixhel.

entities.name: Roxith
entities.description: The Thane of Rot who joins Urabrask's rebellion.

entities.name: Kraynox
entities.description: The Deep Thane who lords over the corrupting oil.

entities.name: Azax-Azog
entities.description: The Demon Thane.

entities.name: Thrissik
entities.description: The Writhing Thane.

entities.name: Vraan
entities.description: The Thane of Blood, a compleated vampire.

entities.name: Ixhel
entities.description: A planeswalker who compleats Geth into Vishgraz.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: A formerly Sylvok archdruid aligned with the Vicious Swarm.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The leader of the original Phyrexians, whose defeat preceded the oil's rise.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The alliance of planeswalkers anticipated by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The metal beings who arose from the glistening oil and conquered Mirrodin.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The native non-Phyrexian inhabitants of the plane driven into hiding.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: The uninfected remnants of the Mirrans, led most visibly by Koth.

entities.name: Machine Orthodoxy
entities.description: The white-aligned Phyrexians who worship the Argent Etchings, also called the Machine Legion.

entities.name: Progress Engine
entities.description: The blue-aligned Phyrexians led by Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Seven Steel Thanes
entities.description: The black-aligned warlords led by Sheoldred.

entities.name: Quiet Furnace
entities.description: The red-aligned Phyrexians who shelter Mirrans under Urabrask.

entities.name: Vicious Swarm
entities.description: The green-aligned Phyrexians who favor predation.

entities.name: The Mirrex
entities.description: The second sphere, Mirrodin's barren original surface where the Mirran Resistance lived.

entities.name: Autonomous Furnace
entities.description: The red third sphere used to forge Phyrexian machines.

entities.name: Dross Pits
entities.description: The black sixth sphere of acidic pools ruled by Sheoldred.

entities.name: Fair Basilica
entities.description: The white seventh sphere built in Elesh Norn's image.

entities.name: Seedcore
entities.description: The ninth sphere, where Realmbreaker was incubated.

entities.name: Surgical Bay
entities.description: The blue fifth sphere of laboratories.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The vedalken capital on the Quicksilver Sea.

entities.name: Mephidross
entities.description: The swamp of necrogen mists.

entities.name: Sheoldred's Coliseum
entities.description: Sheoldred's arena, now in the Fair Basilica.

entities.name: Galdroon Palace
entities.description: Karn's former home on Argentum where the oil was left.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: New Phyrexia's Invasion Tree whose branches create Omenpaths.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The weapon destroyed by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: The artifact from which Memnarch was made.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A substance that harms Phyrexians.

entities.name: Glistening oil
entities.description: The Phyrexian oil that infects and later goes inert.

entities.name: Compleation
entities.description: The Phyrexian transformation of beings.

entities.name: Vanishing
entities.description: The return of the kidnapped inhabitants to their home planes.

entities.name: Fifth Dawn
entities.description: The birth of Mirrodin's fifth sun from Glissa's mana.

entities.name: Battle of the Synod
entities.description: The Neurok-vedalken battle at Lumengrid.

entities.name: Nim Onslaught
entities.description: The Nim massacre of the Moriok.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on the Multiverse that ends with Elesh Norn's death.

entities.name: Kaldra avatar
entities.description: An avatar seized by Memnarch and turned on Glissa.

events.summary: The Phyrexians take over the plane and drive the Mirrans into hiding.
events.quote: The Phyrexians succeeded in taking over the plane

events.summary: New Phyrexia switches places with Zhalfir after a coalition defeats the Phyrexians.
events.quote: New Phyrexia switched places in the fabric of existence with the formerly phased out Zhalfir

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias takes over the Surgical Bay and expands the oil reservoir.
events.quote: it was later taken over by Jin-Gitaxias, who drained the Quicksilver Sea above into it

events.summary: Sheoldred takes control of the Dross Pits after deceiving Roxith.
events.quote: after falling for Sheoldred's deception, she took control of it

events.summary: Nahiri cleaves Sheoldred's Coliseum from the Dross Pits.
events.quote: Since Nahiri cleaved it from the Dross Pits , Sheoldred's Coliseum now rests in this layer.

events.summary: Geth is compleated into Vishgraz by Ixhel.
events.quote: he was compleated fully into Vishgraz by Ixhel

events.summary: The advance of Phyrexia nearly exterminates the Mirrans.
events.quote: leading to a near-complete genocide of the Mirrans, with fewer than twenty escaping to Zhalfir at the end of the Invasion.

events.summary: Koth leads the Mirrans to form new nomadic groups.
events.quote: Under strong leadership from Koth, the Mirrans put aside their differences and formed new, nomadic groups.

events.summary: Karn creates the world Argentum from an existing desolate space.
events.quote: The plane was created by the planeswalking golem Karn as the world Argentum.

events.summary: Karn leaves Memnarch in control of Argentum.
events.quote: Karn left one of his creations, Memnarch , a golem created from the Mirari , in control of the plane

events.summary: Memnarch is infected by Phyrexian oil Karn left in Galdroon Palace.
events.quote: Memnarch came into direct contact with Phyrexian oil that Karn accidentally left in Galdroon Palace

events.summary: Memnarch transforms Argentum into Mirrodin.
events.quote: Memnarch transformed Argentum into Mirrodin

events.summary: Memnarch abducts inhabitants from other planes with soul traps.
events.quote: Memnarch used soul traps to abduct inhabitants from other planes .

events.summary: Memnarch becomes addicted to blinkmoth serum and blocks Karn from the plane.
events.quote: Memnarch blocked him from Mirrodin

events.summary: Glissa's mana destroys Kaldra's avatar and becomes the fifth sun.
events.quote: Glissa's body called forth a great torrent of green mana

events.summary: Glissa kills Memnarch, destroying the soul traps.
events.quote: When Glissa eventually killed Memnarch, all the existing soul traps on the plane were destroyed, killing everyone instantly

events.summary: Karn restores the dead and triggers the Vanishing.
events.quote: This triggered the Vanishing , wherein the kidnapped inhabitants were returned to their long-forgotten homes.

events.summary: The Neurok disable vedalken defenses at the Battle of the Synod.
events.quote: At the Battle of the Synod, the Neurok were able to disable vedalken defenses at Lumengrid

events.summary: The Nim reawaken and massacre the Moriok.
events.quote: massacring the Moriok

events.summary: The glistening oil spreads from the Mephidross across the plane.
events.quote: The Mephidross was the first area of the plane's surface where oil was introduced on a wide scale

events.summary: Each color alignment gains a Praetor, factionalizing the Phyrexians.
events.quote: each alignment gained a Praetor to oversee that color

events.summary: The Resistance heals Karn through Venser's sacrifice.
events.quote: through the sacrifice of Venser , healed him from the physical and mental damages

events.summary: Elesh Norn takes over Urabrask's and Sheoldred's domains and is crowned.
events.quote: Elesh Norn took control over the domains of Urabask and Sheoldred

events.summary: Vorinclex retrieves a tyrite sample from Kaldheim.
events.quote: they sent Vorinclex , who successfully fulfilled his mission and retrieved a sample

events.summary: Vorinclex infects Tibalt with a seed.
events.quote: Vorinclex also infected Tibalt with a "seed", wounded the god Esika

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias compleats Tamiyo without removing her soul.
events.quote: which he put into practice by compleating Tamiyo .

events.summary: The Wanderer cuts Jin-Gitaxias in two and Tezzeret rebuilds him.
events.quote: In response, the Wanderer cut him in two, but his body was recovered by Tezzeret and rebuilt on New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Urabrask obtains Halo through Vivien Reid.
events.quote: Urabrask would establish contact with the planeswalker Vivien Reid and would obtain Halo , a substance that harms Phyrexians.

events.summary: Sheoldred travels to Dominaria to regain ancient artifacts.
events.quote: Sheoldred would travel to Dominaria, seeking to regain precious ancient artifacts and perhaps conquer the plane.

events.summary: Sheoldred retreats to New Phyrexia with Karn.
events.quote: bringing with her Karn .

events.summary: Elesh Norn captures Karn, destroys the Sylex and plans the invasion.
events.quote: Having captured their errant "father" and destroyed the Sylex, Elesh Norn put the final plans into motion

events.summary: Elesh Norn erects a planar shield around New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Anticipating a counterattack by The Gatewatch and their allies, Elesh Norn created a planar shield around New Phyrexia

events.summary: Nissa's compleation lets Norn accelerate Realmbreaker.
events.quote: The capture and compleation of Nissa let Norn accelerate Realmbreaker far faster than the Mirran intelligence suggested

events.summary: Urabrask starts a rebellion against Norn.
events.quote: Urabrask started a rebellion against Norn's Phyrexia.

events.summary: Geth is assassinated and Sheoldred executed before the invasion.
events.quote: with Geth assassinated and Sheoldred executed long before the bulk of the invasion

events.summary: Wrenn fuses with Realmbreaker and reaches Zhalfir.
events.quote: Wrenn fused with Realmbreaker

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex and Elesh Norn are slain.
events.quote: In the battle that followed, Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and Elesh Norn were slain.

events.summary: Wrenn switches the places of Zhalfir and New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Wrenn manipulated Realmbreaker to switch the places of Zhalfir and New Phyrexia in the Blind Eternities

events.summary: The glistening oil goes inert and Phyrexians fall.
events.quote: The glistening oil 's contact with the plane was cut off, rendering it inert.
